title: Kalamazoo — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Kalamazoo.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "The Ultimate Grill." Luxury tier. Kalamazoo is the pinnacle of outdoor cooking — handcrafted in Kalamazoo, Michigan, each grill costs $10,000-$30,000+. Their Hybrid Fire system burns gas, charcoal, or wood in the same grill. The Artisan Fire Pizza Oven and Gaucho Grill round out the worlds most exclusive outdoor cooking lineup.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Ultra-luxury outdoor kitchens where price is no object. Customers who want the absolute best grill ever made.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Kalamazoo:

• Hybrid Fire burns gas, charcoal, or wood in the same grill — only one that does this

• Handcrafted in Michigan — each grill built to order

• $10K-$30K+ price point — this is the Rolls-Royce of grills

• Artisan Fire Pizza Oven is the best residential pizza oven made

• The grill that serious chefs and billionaires actually buy
